card.name: Digits 7-9 inside ISBN and DOI numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, mostly 8 or 9, in the middle of an ISBN, DOI, or similar reference number in a citation. It also fires weakly inside other long numbers such as years, counts and phone numbers.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: A digit in the middle of an ISBN in a book citation.

modes.label: DOI digits
modes.description: A digit inside a DOI string in a journal citation.

modes.label: Other numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a year, patient count or phone number.

card.plain: It marks a middle digit in long reference numbers such as ISBNs and DOIs in citations.
